_comment: Single source of allowed values for records.csv. The loader validates against this; the v1 Google Sheet builds its dropdowns from it. Base-unit ids are generated by scripts/fetch-base.mjs from the historical-basemaps NAME field plus the snapshot year (kebab-case@year) and appended under base_units at build time.

routes._comment: Routes and voyages. path = no direction, arrow = directed; where is an ordered list of Wikidata ids joined by > (ports, capes, straits, caravan cities), resolved by scripts/geocode.mjs into data/gazetteer.json. Points on a route map (a port of call, a capital, a battle) take point_values and are shaped by point_shapes (grammar section 5).

explorers._comment: Explorers layer (owner, 2026-11-06): expeditions of exploration and conquest, shown for a typed range of years and colored by the state that sent them. path = no direction, arrow = directed; where is an ordered list of Wikidata ids joined by > as for routes. value is the sending state for a line; points (stops, landfalls, battles) take point_values. Missionaries and other carriers of an idea are not explorers: they stay under routes (carrier).

military._comment: The Military layer (brief of 2026-11-09; proposal, off by default). Membership of a war is a region row: where = the state id, war = a war id below, side = one of that war's sides, value = the role (region_values), start/end = when it belonged. Events are point rows (point_values), movements arrow rows and lines path rows (values), each with war and side; the seven optional columns (war, side, force, outcome, strength, losses, tech) sit at the end of the table and stay blank on every other row. Milestone 1 reads memberships; events, movements and lines follow.
military._shapes_note: point_shapes are what another layer would draw for these rows; the Military layer draws battles in the victor's color (P5) and forts, headquarters and massacres with marks of their own (P6; the massacre mark awaits the owner and the co-teachers, so it has no shape here and is not drawn until it does).
